description: Source code for a Notion folder document loader component, implementing the INode interface, with methods to load and process documents from a Notion folder, including text splitting and metadata handling.

classes.name: NotionFolder_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class implementing a document loader for Notion folders, capable of loading, splitting, and processing documents with metadata options.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the NotionFolder_DocumentLoaders with default properties.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously loads documents from a specified Notion folder, applies optional text splitting, metadata processing, and returns either documents or concatenated text.
